items.name: Root cause, not symptom
items.note: Test raced a 0.5s wall-clock ceiling against a real-time joiner thread; production max fan-out is 1.36s under load. All three wall-clock exits now patched out of reach; verified failing old test vs passing new test with a 0.8s-starved joiner.

items.name: Test still detects an early-return bug
items.note: Joiner sets the event only after sleep(0.02)+observations; a barrier that returned immediately would leave joined unset.

items.name: No retry/timeout bump
items.note: Ceilings are removed from the assertion's path rather than tuned.

items.name: Docs/hooks impact
items.note: Test-only, no hook or phase change.
